WITH source_data AS (

    SELECT
        TRIM(CUSTOMER_ID) AS CUSTOMER_ID,
        TRIM(NAME) AS CUSTOMER_NAME,
        LOWER(TRIM(EMAIL)) AS EMAIL,
        TRIM(CITY) AS CITY,
        COALESCE(
            TRY_TO_DATE(TRIM(SIGNUP_DATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
            TRY_TO_DATE(TRIM(SIGNUP_DATE), 'MM/DD/YYYY'),
            TRY_TO_DATE(TRIM(SIGNUP_DATE), 'DD/MM/YYYY')
        ) AS SIGNUP_DATE
    FROM ECOMMERCE_DB.RAW.CUSTOMERS

),

cleaned AS (

    SELECT
        TRY_TO_NUMBER(CUSTOMER_ID) AS CUSTOMER_ID,
        NULLIF(CUSTOMER_NAME, '') AS CUSTOMER_NAME,
        NULLIF(EMAIL, '') AS EMAIL,
        NULLIF(CITY, '') AS CITY,
        SIGNUP_DATE
    FROM source_data

)

SELECT *
FROM cleaned
WHERE CUSTOMER_ID IS NOT NULL
  AND CUSTOMER_NAME IS NOT NULL
  AND SIGNUP_DATE IS NOT NULL

WITH source_data AS (

    SELECT
        TRIM(ORDER_ID) AS ORDER_ID,
        TRIM(CUSTOMER_ID) AS CUSTOMER_ID,
        TRIM(PRODUCT_ID) AS PRODUCT_ID,
        TRIM(QUANTITY) AS QUANTITY,
        TRIM(ORDER_DATE) AS ORDER_DATE,
        LOWER(TRIM(ORDER_STATUS)) AS ORDER_STATUS
    FROM ECOMMERCE_DB.RAW.ORDERS

),

cleaned AS (

    SELECT
        TRY_TO_NUMBER(ORDER_ID) AS ORDER_ID,
        TRY_TO_NUMBER(CUSTOMER_ID) AS CUSTOMER_ID,
        TRY_TO_NUMBER(PRODUCT_ID) AS PRODUCT_ID,
        TRY_TO_NUMBER(QUANTITY) AS QUANTITY,
        COALESCE(
            TRY_TO_DATE(ORDER_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
            TRY_TO_DATE(ORDER_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY'),
            TRY_TO_DATE(ORDER_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
        ) AS ORDER_DATE,
        CASE
            WHEN ORDER_STATUS IN ('complete', 'completed') THEN 'completed'
            WHEN ORDER_STATUS IN ('cancel', 'canceled', 'cancelled') THEN 'cancelled'
            WHEN ORDER_STATUS = 'pending' THEN 'pending'
            WHEN ORDER_STATUS = 'shipped' THEN 'shipped'
            WHEN ORDER_STATUS IN ('processing', 'in progress') THEN 'processing'
            WHEN ORDER_STATUS IN ('returned', 'refunded') THEN 'returned'
            ELSE 'unknown'
        END AS ORDER_STATUS
    FROM source_data

)

SELECT
    o.*
FROM cleaned AS o
WHERE o.ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL

-- Combine staged orders, customers, and products.
-- Revenue is calculated for each order line.

WITH orders AS (
    SELECT * FROM ECOMMERCE_DB.STAGING_STAGING.stg_orders
),

customers AS (
    SELECT * FROM ECOMMERCE_DB.STAGING_STAGING.stg_customers
),

products AS (
    SELECT * FROM ECOMMERCE_DB.STAGING_STAGING.stg_products
)

SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    c.customer_name,
    o.product_id,
    p.product_name,
    p.category,
    o.order_date,
    o.quantity,
    p.price AS unit_price,
    o.quantity * p.price AS order_revenue,
    o.order_status AS status
FROM orders AS o
INNER JOIN customers AS c
    ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
INNER JOIN products AS p
    ON o.product_id = p.product_id

WITH order_lines AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        c.customer_name,
        o.product_id,
        p.product_name,
        p.category,
        o.order_date,
        o.quantity,
        p.price AS unit_price,
        o.quantity * p.price AS line_revenue,
        LOWER(o.order_status) AS status
    FROM ECOMMERCE_DB.STAGING_STAGING.stg_orders AS o
    INNER JOIN ECOMMERCE_DB.STAGING_STAGING.stg_customers AS c
        ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    INNER JOIN ECOMMERCE_DB.STAGING_STAGING.stg_products AS p
        ON o.product_id = p.product_id
),

order_summary AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        customer_name,
        order_date,
        status,
        COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS product_count,
        LISTAGG(DISTINCT product_name, ', ')
            WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY product_name) AS product_details,
        SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN status = 'completed' THEN line_revenue
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS order_revenue
    FROM order_lines
    GROUP BY
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        customer_name,
        order_date,
        status
)

SELECT *
FROM order_summary

SELECT

    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,

                THEN o.quantity * p.price
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS total_revenue
FROM ECOMMERCE_DB.STAGING_STAGING.stg_orders AS o
INNER JOIN ECOMMERCE_DB.STAGING_STAGING.stg_products AS p
    ON o.product_id = p.product_id

-- Calculate completed sales revenue by product category.

SELECT
    category,
    SUM(order_revenue) AS total_revenue
FROM ECOMMERCE_DB.STAGING_MARTS.fct_order_details
WHERE LOWER(status) = 'completed'
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
